question: If an AI can make a talking video of anyone from one photo, how will we know what is real?
reflection: Cheaper tools for making video and code can let small teams tell their own stories, if we also teach people to check what they see.

sources.subject: Cursor agents now ship code while you sleep, no input needed
Meituan LongCat Avatar: photo+audio to lip-sync video, MIT free

one_line: AI tools are working with less human input, from coding agents that act on their own to free models that make talking videos from a single photo.

top_stories.title: Free model turns a photo into a talking video
top_stories.what: Meituan released an open model that takes one picture and a voice clip and produces a realistic talking-head video, free for commercial use.
top_stories.why: Training videos become cheap to make, but so do convincing fakes of real people.

top_stories.title: Coding agents that start work on their own
top_stories.what: Cursor's cloud agents can now wake up when a message or code change arrives, follow tasks to the end and send helpers to work on separate machines.
top_stories.why: Teams will need clear rules on what an agent may start without a person asking.

top_stories.title: AI reported to persuade better than experts
top_stories.what: A study reportedly found that leading models out-argue expert humans and are close to three times better at raising money.
top_stories.why: Persuasion is a core behavioural topic, and this raises questions about fair use of AI in campaigns and fundraising.

saudi_lens.text: Cheap talking-avatar tools could help Saudi agencies make Arabic training videos at scale, but also call for clear labelling of synthetic media.

idea.title: Persuasion guardrails for public messages
idea.pitch: Test how people react to AI-written public appeals compared with human ones, and what disclosure wording keeps trust.
idea.first_step: Write two versions of one public health message and plan a small online comparison.

idea_kids.title: Real or made?
idea_kids.pitch: A picture-card game where children sort photos and drawings into real and made, then talk about the clues they used.
idea_kids.first_step: Gather twelve images, half real photos and half clearly drawn or edited, all child-friendly.

terms.definition: Video, audio or images made by AI to look like a real person saying or doing something they did not.
A helper agent that a main agent starts to handle one part of a larger task.
The software around a model that gives it tools, memory and a loop for carrying out tasks.

concepts.summary: Free tools make realistic talking videos from one photo, raising the need for labels and checks.
Agents that wake on events and pursue goals until done.
Models reportedly persuade people better than experts do.
